name: Effort::from_str / Effort::try_from(u8)

"1".."5" map to Low..Max (the chatlog's numeric form).
Display prints the lowercase name and parsing it returns the same level.
Every u8 either maps to a level (1..=5) or returns an error; no panic.
proptest: a < b as levels iff a.as_u8() < b.as_u8().

output_description: One of Low, Medium, High, XHigh, Max; models map levels to Nemotron tiers.
